resource_revision: The initial 13,608-trajectory launch was terminated before any output file was produced. This reduced matrix was frozen before the first completed outcome and preserves every domain, topology and rho level.
central_test: Do correlated, physically coherent parameter families preserve the information-limited and mismatch-limited participation mechanisms without post-result retuning?
claim_boundary: prospective heterogeneous computational stress test; not source-controller replay, entity HIL, hardware, or independent physical identification
pairing: Within each domain-size-topology-rho-seed block, policies share initial conditions, correlated plant parameters and exogenous innovations.

promotion_rule.window_claim_requires: at least one prespecified low and high rho with lower success than an interior rho in each claimed domain
